sloka: तथोक्तवति देवेशे गोप्रतारमुपागताः ।भेजिरे सरयूं सर्वे हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः ।। ७.११०.२३ ॥
transliteration: tathoktavati deveśe gopratāramupāgatāḥ ।bhejire sarayūṁ sarve harṣapūrṇāśruviklavāḥ ।। 7.110.23 ॥

translations.english: When the lord of gods had thus spoken, all those who had arrived at Gopratara, overwhelmed with tears of joy, entered the Sarayu river.
